title: Aligning Faithfulness for Theory-Scale Autoformalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. translated_title: 面向理论尺度自动形式化的忠实性对齐
translated_abstract: 自动形式化（AF）所需的不只是编译：形式化陈述必须保留其非形式化来源的含义，这一性质被称为忠实性。对这一性质进行自动化评估是一个新兴前沿方向，然而现有大多数方法都在语句层面运作并给出整体性的判定结果，无法揭示各个表达式之间如何一一对应，也无法说明哪些上下文解释支撑了判定结论。这一缺失影响重大，因为自动形式化本质上是理论尺度的：目标陈述的含义源自周围的数学材料和未明说的约定。我们将忠实性评估形式化为一个上下文感知的“先对齐后标注”问题：识别非形式化陈述与形式化陈述之间短语级别的对应关系，并在明确指定的上下文解释与假设下，为每个对应关系分配忠实性标签。我们还引入了FaithAlign，这是首个理论尺度的忠实性基准
tldr: 该论文将自动形式化中的忠实性评估形式化为上下文感知的“先对齐后标注”问题，在短语级别建立非形式化与形式化陈述的对应关系并逐项标注忠实性，同时发布了首个理论尺度忠实性基准FaithAlign。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates faithfulness evaluation for autoformalization as a context-aware align-then-label problem, establishing phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements with per-correspondence faithfulness labels, and introduces FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark.
